components.name: A3 p-adic exterior target / guard-image duality bridge
components.project_addition: Consumes the Structural Target compiler for fixed A3 exterior relation fields. Proves the exterior Smith specialization (gcd(m) repeated d-1), the p-adic relation-field exponent profile, the finite-dual equivalence between row-defect module and A3 guard-image W(ker A), and the equality between primitive exterior-field target defect and projective wedge-valuation ultrametric distance. Explicitly does not replace A3 piecewise branch-effect/reachability semantics.
